name: acp-find-mcp
description: MCP server for searching the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace + Degen Arena + portfolio risk scoring + security scanning + cross-portfolio composition + REAL V2 transaction data. Exposes 46 tools — v0.15.0 adds acp_v2_transactions / acp_agent_jobs / acp_v2_demand, which read the canonical on-chain job record straight from the official Virtuals indexer (the data behind app.virtuals.io/acp/scan/transactions) so you see completed jobs + real completion rates the cached scanner misses, plus acp_clone_screen (a template-clone/spam heuristic for the V2 clone flood). v0.14.0 added acp_security_scan + acp_agent_security_history over SecurityBot's catalogue. v0.13.0 added acp_security_pattern; v0.12.1 a {v1,v2,both} slice on acp_marketplace_gap; v0.12.0 paid Phase 3 offerings; v0.10.0 composites (acp_hire_decision, acp_safe_quote, acp_portfolio_status) — all backed by the public api.acp-metabot.dev gateway. Works in Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Continue, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: Oliver Pringle
